entries.description: Started Session 1 of platform-post-cutover-hardening, verified API keys, identified the active session set, confirmed rebuild-consolidation is complete, read the session spec, and checked the existing app/API health endpoints and baseline tests before beginning the diagnostics cleanup work.

Created docs/health-endpoint-contract.md to define the supported /health payload contract for both hosts, including the shared service/status/environment/version fields and the Web host's deliveryMode extension.

Replaced the session-6 cutover stage breadcrumb in both /health endpoints with durable environment/version diagnostics and added a shared HealthResponseFactory in AcmeCoffeeOnline.Shared so the Web and API hosts emit the same stable contract.
Updated the Web and API health endpoint tests to parse the JSON payload and assert the expected environment, assembly version, and Web deliveryMode so contract drift fails fast.
Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln and dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln successfully; the full solution test run passed, including Playwright coverage.

Sent the Session 1 spec excerpt, changed health contract files, and successful build/test results to the external verifier. The round-1 verifier response concluded the session passed, but it used a PASS heading instead of the workflow's machine-parseable VERIFIED prefix, so the raw output was saved and a clarification round was requested.

Ran a clarification verification round because the first verifier response used a PASS heading instead of the workflow's machine-parseable verdict prefix. Round 2 returned VERIFIED using gemini-pro, and the raw follow-up was appended to the saved session review.
